name: sparedroid
description: Turn a spare Android phone into an API: a skill for setting up and running SpareDroid, plus its MCP server (read screens, tap, type, answer chat mentions).

sparedroid_home.title: SpareDroid directory
sparedroid_home.description: The directory where `sparedroid serve` runs (it holds .env and data/). Install the server first: pip install "sparedroid[mcp]".

readonly.title: Read-only
readonly.description: Only allow tools that look (no tapping, typing or sending). Recommended while setting up.
